research.title: Calibration Evaluation for Regularized Binary Classifiers
bullets: Implemented assigned routines for fitting regularized logistic regression models and generating calibration curves under a predefined evaluation protocol.
Checked preprocessing consistency across training and validation splits, and summarized probability calibration patterns using Brier scores and reliability diagrams.

work.title: Order Processing and Inventory Coordination
bullets: Processed incoming orders, verified shipment paperwork against order records, and referred discrepancies to the appropriate staff for resolution.
Maintained inventory logs, coordinated routine stock checks, and prepared daily handover notes covering outstanding deliveries and pending customer requests.

projects.title: Regularized Regression Baselines for Tabular Prediction
bullets: Implemented ordinary least squares and ridge regression baselines in scikit-learn, using training-set standardization and held-out data for evaluation.
Selected ridge penalties through cross-validation and compared residual distributions to examine sensitivity to correlated predictors and departures from linear assumptions.
